image: Thunder over the marsh: A Sister Marries.
So the noble one, through to the very end,
lines: A sister is married as a younger handmaid.
It is good for the hidden one to hold firm.
A sister is married as one who waits —
then she returns, and is married as a handmaid.
A sister's marriage misses its date,
but married late, she still has her time.
Di Yi gives his sister in marriage.
The ruler's sleeves are not as fine
The moon is almost full: good.
The woman holds out a basket, but nothing is in it.
The young man stabs a sheep, but no blood comes.

notes.name_en: 歸妹 a younger sister given in marriage; 'A Sister Marries', not Wilhelm's 'The Marrying Maiden'.
notes.L3: 須 a waiting-servant/attendant status; 娣 the younger sister-bridesmaid who accompanies the bride.
